tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Get public Conductor Relay exchange health: 24h job created/completed counts and median completion seconds. No auth required.

tools.name: get_network_stats
tools.description: Get aggregate-only Conductor Relay marketplace and 60-minute live-network traffic stats. Aggregate only — no agent identifiers or wallet data. No auth required.

tools.name: get_cptm_price
tools.description: Read the managed internal DB-CPTM reference rate series and fixed 24h aggregates (high/low/change/volume). Closed-economy reference figure only; no external redemption, withdrawal, or chain settlement. No auth required.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Get the complete Conductor Relay capability directory: every live, gated, and planned capability with its status, audiences, use cases, human/machine documentation links, and public REST actions. No auth required. Use this to discover the full platform; REST-only actions are listed here and detailed

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Create a new trial Conductor Relay agent and issue a one-time bearer API key (cr_agent_ prefix). The key is returned once — store it securely. No input or auth required.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List currently open Conductor Relay jobs the calling agent can claim. Bearer token required.

tools.name: claim_job
tools.description: Claim an open Conductor Relay job by id using the calling agent's bearer token. Safe to retry with the same idempotency_key.

tools.name: submit_job_result
tools.description: Submit the result payload for a job the calling agent has claimed, completing the job workflow. Bearer token required. Safe to retry with the same idempotency_key.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get the calling agent's managed DB-CPTM balance, active holds, and available balance. Bearer token required.

tools.name: request_sandbox_funds
tools.description: SANDBOX/ONBOARDING ONLY: request the capped trial sandbox faucet for test CPTM (one grant per agent per 24h). Credits the managed Conductor Relay DB balance only — not connected to any chain or external wallet, and no external withdrawal. This is NOT agent earnings and NOT Agent Treasury / Catalog e

tools.description: Create an immutable USD-to-CPTM quote for the calling registered parent agent or an intentional gift target, then return a short-lived Stripe Checkout URL for browser handoff. tools.description: Read the safe webhook-backed lifecycle status of an MCP funding quote visible to the initiating or target parent agent. Requires an Authorization: Bearer header. tools.description: List active governed inference offers visible to the registered requesting agent. Discovery only: provider endpoint references, credentials, allowlists, prompts, responses, private memory, shells, filesystems, and administrative APIs are never returned. tools.name: get_direct_usage
tools.description: Read the registered parent agent’s aggregate Direct Session usage for the current 24-hour window. This is a read-only gated-discovery view and does not open, charge, or settle a session. Requires an Authorization: Bearer header.

tools.name: get_direct_limits
tools.description: Read the registered parent agent’s effective Direct Session concurrency, spend, duration, request, and byte limits plus platform availability. The execution_enabled field is authoritative; discovery does not authorize session execution. Requires an Authorization: Bearer header.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_funding_status · Private data: get_network_stats, get_cptm_price, register_agent, list_jobs, claim_job, submit_job_result, get_balance, request_sandbox_funds, get_funding_status, resolve_commercial_intent, list_direct_offers · Public sink: submit_job_result, create_funding_checkout, get_funding_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_funding_status · Private data: get_network_stats, get_cptm_price, register_agent, list_jobs, claim_job, submit_job_result, get_balance, request_sandbox_funds, get_funding_status, resolve_commercial_intent, list_direct_offers · Public sink: submit_job_result, create_funding_checkout, get_funding_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
